title: Left-hand bass styles, Freddie Newman and octaves versus single notes
summary: He explains single-note bass versus octaves, Freddie Newman's playing, and the piano's supporting role.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
